summary: The PR advances the Layer 4 ReductiveGroups milestone 'Jordan decomposition of elements into semisimple and unipotent parts (geometric, over k̄), functorial under representations' by supplying the semisimple-element predicate itself, with prerequisite Layers 1 and 2 already on main. It is a single unit: every added general-linear-group lemma is consumed by the point-level API.
